newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Oct 17.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on Oct 16. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy. Telephone: (6221) 384-6364. Fax: (6221) 344-8404.
Flour mill operator PT Bogasari Sudwikatmono said that it had no intention of selling its 4.57 percent stake in car manufacturer PT Astra International.

Members of Indonesia's ruling Golkar political party opened the annual party congress, saying they expect to increase their share of the vote from 68 percent in the 1992 general elections to 71 percent in 1997.

The Association of Indonesian Importers has threatened to boycott Japanese goods. A spokesman said that the boycott will come into effect if the recent Japanese decision to take Indonesia to the World Trade Organisation (WTO) over its contreversial national car policy has an adverse effect on the Indonesian economy.
Indonesia's current cement shortage is likely to continue in the near future, but an oversupply was likely in 2003 if all 32 firms given permits to build cement firms go ahead with their plans.
